items.title: Inside the Supermassive Debate Over the James Webb Telescope’s ‘Little Red Dots’
items.content_text: The Webb telescope sees tiny red dots everywhere. Astronomers can’t agree on what they are, but some believe they may be enormous stars with black holes inside.
items.summary: The Webb telescope sees tiny red dots everywhere. Astronomers can’t agree on what they are, but some believe they may be enormous stars with black holes inside.

items.title: The ‘Exotic Physics’ Behind a Mysterious 1,000-Mile Cloud on Mars
items.content_text: The cloud has baffled astronomers since its discovery in 2018. Now, a new study offers a possible cause for its appearance.
